about: revmoves2 (2026-11-20; Farooq on pad 2 with nothing pressed, so once down he stays down long and a dive comes down ON him -- with him CPU the dives of 900 s all missed; the user, round 2: 'Ultimo Dragon does the jump, but he clips to standing immediately after'): his match as he played it -- Ultimo Dragon (Revenge import 0x0376, slot 0) against Farooq (WrestleMania 2000 import 0x03AA) -- a handicap match, Ultimo and Kidman (0x0361) against Farooq, so Farooq is down often and the down-target dives come (in singles, 420 s: no dive at all); Ultimo is CPU here (the user had pad 1: the dive's states don't depend on who presses), his turnbuckle moves (entries 250-274: the down-target dives and the others, so he climbs more often -- one dive in 600 s with 261-264 only) all done as his entry 261, 'revenge:1bc5_1bc6@<move>'. Revenge's dive is a dive with a cover (five roles, its second the landing INTO a cover, as No Mercy's 12430, a dive flagged 0x200); played on No Mercy's 12380 (a dive without one: its second role is a landing that stands him up) the game played the cover landing and stood him up out of it. With the fix it stays on 12380 (a dive at a lying man) with the cover flag (his moves.json records: byte 0x22 = 0x22): a hit square on the man goes from the cover landing into the pin (Ultimo 68, Farooq 69), any other hit lands with Revenge's own landing (the fifth role = its fourth file) and he gets up; no clip. Shots while he dives, covers, and the step after a dive. Matches one after another until the time is up.

expect.name: Ultimo Dragon and Kidman (Revenge) against Farooq (WrestleMania 2000)
Ultimo dove off the turnbuckle with his library dive (121-125)
a dive of his came down on Farooq lying: Farooq hit (99) or covered (69)
expect.check: ((s0_phase >= 121 and s0_phase <= 125) or s0_phase == 68) and (s2_phase == 99 or s2_phase == 69)

expect.name: his dive went into its cover (Ultimo 68, Farooq 69) on No Mercy's 12380 with the cover (record byte 0x22 = 0x22): a hit square on the lying man goes from the cover landing to the pin
no model's matrices ever went bad
nobody's position went bad
